title: SRE weekly update - 2026-07-11
content:
SRE Weekly Update - 2026-07-11

Summary:
- Quiet week for major customer impact; two user-visible incidents (P1 and P2) with limited blast radius.
- SLOs generally healthy but error-budget burn on the embeddings service is creeping up.
- On-call rotation continued without escalations for infra-layer. Some follow-ups required for autoscaler tuning.

Incidents:
1) JIRA-INC-2489 — Embeddings ingestion throttling (2026-07-09 03:12 UTC -> 2026-07-09 05:06 UTC) — P1
   - Impact: ~8% of embeddings requests experienced 429s or 504s; affected a subset of heavy-batch jobs using dedicated pools in us-west2.
   - Root cause (preliminary): mis-sized autoscaler policy + recently deployed batch-job change that increased simultaneous long-running requests. Autoscaler policy did not scale fast enough under spike pattern.
   - Mitigation: manual scale up of dedicated pools, temporary circuit-breaker (rate limiter) added to job runner to smooth bursts.
   - Next steps: refine autoscaler cooldown/scale-step for dedicated pools (action item), add a guardrail to prevent >N concurrent long-running batch requests per tenant. Postmortem draft linked (JIRA-INC-2489).

2) JIRA-INC-2492 — Console: charting backend 500s during heavy query loads (2026-07-10 14:07 UTC -> 2026-07-10 16:40 UTC) — P2
   - Impact: Console dashboards intermittently returned 500s for ~20 minutes windows when analytics job kicked off. Not customer-facing API, primarily internal/console UX.
   - Root cause: query planning path hit an unoptimized DB index scan under newly added aggregated metrics.
   - Mitigation: deployed a lightweight index and rolled back the aggregation change.
   - Next steps: add pre-deploy load test for console analytics queries, add DB explain plan checks to CI.

SLOs / Metrics:
- Serving API availability (global): 99.94% (rolling 30d) — within SLO (99.9%). No change.
- Text-generation request latency p99 (hosted): 480ms (7d) — improvement after kernel change last week.
- Embeddings service availability (30d): 99.82% — error budget burn accelerating, current 30d burn = 76% of monthly budget.
- Action: org-ask to reduce batch ingestion concurrency by default and to prioritize autoscaler tuning for embeddings pools.

On-call handoffs / notes:
- Week rotation: On-call primary: Ravi Patel; secondary: Melanie Ortiz; pager duty coverage verified.
- Handoff highlights (2026-07-11 morning):
   - Ravi: all active incidents mitigated, left two follow-ups for autoscaler tuning and runbook update.
   - Melanie: will own the postmortem run and follow through with the autoscaler PR.
- Runbook gaps observed: embeddings runbook missing explicit guidance for manual scale steps on dedicated pools and lacks a runbooked circuit-breaker rollout procedure. Action: add two playbook pages and link them to runbooks repo.

Planned maintenance / changes:
- 2026-07-18 02:00-04:00 UTC: rolling kernel/driver update on gpu-pool-us-west2 (low-impact, will drain non-production pods first). Change request under review (https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482).
- 2026-07-20: deploy autoscaler tuning (staged rollout: canary -> 24h monitor -> full). Will monitor embeddings SLO closely during rollout.

Action items (owners):
- Ravi: finish postmortem draft for JIRA-INC-2489 and publish review (due 2026-07-13).
- Melanie: open autoscaler tuning PR with conservative scale step and cooldown changes; include canary config (due 2026-07-12).
- Ethan: add circuit-breaker implementation to batch-job runner repo and create feature flag for gradual enable (due 2026-07-16).
- Ava (me): update embeddings runbook with manual scale/runbook steps and link to postmortem (due 2026-07-14).

Runbooks / Playbooks:
- Added temporary playbook: "embeddings-burst-mitigation" (linked in runbooks). Needs formal review by eng-sre.
- Recommended edits: include explicit metrics to watch (queue depth, concurrent long-running tasks, p95/p99 latency) and the exact GCP instance groups to scale.

Meetings / Notes:
- Weekly SRE sync (2026-07-09): discussed availability trends, added autoscaler tuning to priority backlog, agreed to run a capacity test for embeddings on 2026-07-16 (private infra testing).
- Postmortem review scheduled 2026-07-13 15:00 UTC (invite sent).

Other notes / context:
- Observability: added dashboard for "dedicated-pool-concurrency" to make burst patterns easier to spot; saved a snapshot and shared with infra team.
- Cost: temporary scale up for mitigation increased spend for the week ~6% on dedicated pools — finance notified for FYI.

Risks / blockers:
- If autoscaler tuning is delayed, embeddings error budget could hit 100% in the next 3-4 weeks under current growth.
- Need consent from platform team for circuit-breaker default; feature flags will be used to rollout gradually.

Appendix / links:
- Postmortem draft: JIRA-INC-2489 (link in linked_artifacts)
- Console analytics rollback PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/479
- Runbooks repo: CONFLUENCE-SRE-RUNBOOKS

If you want more raw logs/metrics slices I can paste the query outputs in this doc or link dashboards.

— Ava
